propositions: review-code fails to resolve an activated project-owned code-review prompt located in .rebar/prompts.

Project prompt resolution should work consistently across attested and local source modes without altering built-in prompt behavior.
Unknown project prompt identifiers must still fail closed with a clear error.
The issue traces to repo_root propagation into project criteria routing and prompt loading.
